methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia Tech adopts universitywide human-centered AI vision | ETIH EdTech News - EdTech Innovation Hub
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's universitywide human-centered AI vision signals institutional capacity-building beyond NoVA, potentially seeding deep, distributed capability through educational infrastructure in the New River Valley that could radiate to surrounding regions.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents peer-to-peer skill-building infrastructure emerging outside traditional tech hubs, suggesting potential for deep capability distribution if sustained, though scale and regional reach remain uncertain.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools adopting ChatGPT under institutional oversight signals shallow, platform-dependent AI distribution—broad exposure without deep technical capability development, fitting the 'software does it' pattern across Hampton Roads education sector.

signals.title: Top federal broadband official visits Bedford County, touts connectivity
signals.signal_reading: Federal broadband official visiting Bedford County highlights that Southside still struggles with foundational connectivity infrastructure—a prerequisite gap that prevents even shallow AI adoption, reinforcing concentrated capability patterns elsewhere.

signals.title: Emerald AI reaches unicorn status with $1.05B valuation - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: Emerald AI achieving unicorn status at $1.05B valuation concentrates capital, talent, and advanced AI capability in NoVA's ecosystem, deepening the excellence pocket while the region's gravity well pulls resources from potential distributed alternatives.
